messages.en:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Oh, HEY!{01 00 00 05 00} Your hands are
full! {01 00 00 05 00}That means I don't
have to give you anything!
{07 00 00}Well, at least until you
unload your pockets. Come
back when you do!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}Oi, HEI!{01 00 00 05 00} Su käed on
täis! {01 00 00 05 00}See tähendab, et ma
ei pea sulle midagi andma!
{07 00 00}Noh, vähemalt seni, kuni sa
taskud tühjendad. Tule
siis tagasi!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Hey now,{01 00 00 05 00} you're pockets are
full of junk, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

Way to go! You just keep
proving again and again
that you don't have a clue!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuule nüüd,{01 00 00 05 00} su taskud on
rämpsu täis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

Tubli töö! Sa tõestad aina
uuesti ja uuesti,
et sul pole aimugi!
